text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for Tracen Academy's annual summer camp, and Sakura Chiyono O is fired up from day one.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer… I swear I'm going to become Maruzen's rival one day.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I may not be as strong as her yet. I may not have what it takes to draw out her fighting spirit right now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But if I give up on things because I assume they're impossible, I'll never be able to accomplish anything.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: In other words, "if you don't reach out your hand, you can't turn on the faucet"! Let's do this, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, my summer camp with Sakura Chiyono O gets underway!
